plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 4-date timeline completes: 17 Jan 1912 (Alexis Carrel starts his 34-year chicken-heart culture, launching the myth of natural cell immortality) · Dec 1961 (Leonard Hayflick & Paul Moorhead prove normal human fibroblasts stop dividing after ~50 doublings, the Hayflick Limit) · 1971 & Mar 1978–1982 (Alexey Olovnikov predicts the DNA end-replication problem; Elizabeth Blackburn & Jack Szostak sequence TTGGGG telomere repeats and prove cross-species protection in yeast) · 25 Dec 1984 (Carol Greider & Elizabeth Blackburn discover telomerase on Christmas Day at UC Berkeley; 2009 Nobel Prize with Szostak).
